values: basedpyright
<rule>
^(?:report[A-Z]\w*|type-error)$
basedpyright/reportAny
A diagnostic of basedpyright, named by its <rule>.
The Python preset runs the type checker the project picks (`python.typeChecker`: mypy, pyright or basedpyright) and fails a diagnostic the change adds.
Fix the type; inline ignores are banned.
reportDeprecated
A basedpyright diagnostic with the rule reportDeprecated.
The Python preset runs the type checker the project picks and fails a diagnostic the change adds.
Call the replacement the deprecation notice names; the deprecated API is going away.
reportMissingImports
A basedpyright diagnostic with the rule reportMissingImports.
Install the package, or its `types-` stubs, in the project environment.
reportMissingModuleSource
A basedpyright diagnostic with the rule reportMissingModuleSource.
dependencies
no-dev-dependency-in-production
Production code imports a package that is only a dev dependency.
A production install does not have dev dependencies, so the import fails there.
Move the dependency to the runtime dependencies, or stop importing it in production code.
unlisted-dependency
A package that code imports but the project manifest does not list.
An import that works only because another package pulls it in breaks when that package changes.
Add it to the project dependencies (a dev dependency group for tests and tooling).
unused-dependency
A dependency in the project manifest that no code imports.
Unused dependencies add install time and attack surface.
Remove it from the manifest.
import-linter
contract-broken
An import that breaks an import-linter contract.
The Python preset checks the import contracts of the project (`python.importLinter`) so that layers keep their direction.
Remove the import; move the code to the layer that may depend on it.
mutmut
mutant-ignored
A `# pragma: no mutate` comment or a mutmut ignore pattern that hides code from mutation testing.
An ignored mutant cannot fail, so an ignore comment hides code from the mutation check.
Remove the comment or pattern and test the code.

values.note: Ignore comments and patterns are not an exception route.
